sentences.text: Anthony Scaramucci -LRB- born January 6 , 1964 -RRB- is an American entrepreneur , financier , political figure , and author .

On January 12 , 2017 , President Donald Trump announced his intent to appoint Scaramucci Director of the White House Office of Public Liaison and Intergovernmental Affairs .	Donald Trump	Donald Trump	White House Office of Public Liaison and Intergovernmental Affairs	White House Office of Public Engagement and Intergovernmental Affairs

Scaramucci 's swearing-in was reportedly delayed by an extended review of his finances by the Office of Government Ethics , although the ethics office denied that clearance was necessary before making White House appointments .	Office of Government Ethics	Office of Government Ethics
Ultimately , George Sifakis was appointed instead .	George Sifakis	George Sifakis
Following the 2016 election , Scaramucci served on the Presidential Transition Team Executive Committee .

In 2005 , Scaramucci founded global investment firm SkyBridge Capital , serving as co-managing partner before selling the company in early 2017 to take a role in the Trump administration .	SkyBridge Capital	SkyBridge Capital
Scaramucci also previously served as host of a financial television show Wall Street Week and contributor to the Fox News Channel .	Wall Street Week	Wall Street Week	Fox News Channel	Fox News Channel
